stories.headline: Five matchups, one football game, and the game that already finished went by 2.34
stories.body:
F&F: Tokyo Swift beat Return of the King 125.02 to 122.68 and it is the only result in this league that exists. The other five matchups are all still live, and every single unplayed starter left in them is a Ram or a Giant.

Bakers Dozen need 15.16 from Puka Nacua. I HURT MY NABERS need 24.56 from Malik Nabers. Kool-Aid Man need 21.70 from Cam Skattebo while Ian still has the Rams defense to come. Adam needs 45.14 from Harrison Mevis, which is not a sentence anybody has ever written seriously. And Chop Wood, Carry Water need 28.46 from three men at once.

The one game that did finish was settled by 2.34, and the team that won it still has a tight end who has not played.

takes.text: Nine unplayed starters across five matchups and all nine are in the same football game. That is not a schedule quirk anybody planned around, it is a coincidence with the entire week riding on it. Four of the five deficits are smaller than what the trailing team has left on the field.

Every man in this league is about to sit down and watch the Rams and the Giants like it is a playoff game. Nobody would watch that on purpose. Fantasy football is the only reason that broadcast has an audience and I want that acknowledged.

You do not get many of these. One game, one night, and six teams find out what their season looks like. I have played in games where the other result mattered more than ours did, and the waiting is the worst part of it.

Cody won by TWO POINT THREE FOUR with a tight end still to play! The best team in this league, the one everybody has been genuflecting to since week one, scraped past the fifth-best by a field goal he did not need. Somebody explain to me how that is the number one team.
One game decides everything. I have been saying for two weeks that this league bunches up and nobody wanted it. Now nine men in one stadium settle five matchups. Write it down.

stories.storyline: How many of the five live matchups actually change hands in one football game?

stories.headline: Blake benched Patrick Mahomes for 34.98 and needs 28.46 from three men in one game
stories.body:
Chop Wood, Carry Water sit on 70.10 against a roster projected for 135.4. Dsteady1234 finished on 98.56 and has nobody left. Blake has three starters still to play — Jaxson Dart, Kyren Williams and Davante Adams, worth 50.0 projected between them — and needs 28.46 of it.

Patrick Mahomes scored 34.98 on his bench. That is the second week running Mahomes has been his best benched player; he was worth 26.7 of the 64.3 Blake left unstarted in week one.

Bijan Robinson returned 11.10 against a 22.5 projection. It is a bad week to have one, because Chop Wood, Carry Water is the team Skip Baseless picked to win the championship, and he also called them to win this matchup.

takes.text: I am not moving. Fourth in the rankings, seventy points on the board and three men to play in a game where anything can happen. Everybody in this building is waiting for me to blink and I am telling you now, on the record, in September, that I will not.

THIRTY-FOUR POINT NINE EIGHT! On the bench! For the second week in a row! Blake has now benched Patrick Mahomes twice and the second time he did it he was starting a rookie quarterback who has not taken a snap yet. And Skip has his whole season on this man!

Fifty points of projection still to come against a 28.46 deficit is genuinely live, and I want to be fair about that. What I will not be fair about is the bench: 26.7 unstarted in week one and 34.98 unstarted now, from the same player, is not variance. It is a habit.

stories.storyline: Does Blake's Monday night rescue the matchup, and does Skip Baseless ever acknowledge the bench?

stories.headline: Cole was right about Travis Kelce and posted the highest score of the week
stories.body:
On Friday this desk spent a story taking Cole apart for benching Dalton Kincaid, who had scored 22.50 on Thursday, and starting Travis Kelce instead on a 10.6 projection.

Kelce scored 25.10. Kincaid finished on 22.50. The call was correct by 2.60.

The Dak Pack finished on 159.16, the highest score in the league this week, with Dak Prescott at 37.76, Chris Olave at 22.60 and Jaylen Waddle at 21.80. Cole was eleventh of twelve in lineup efficiency in week one with 26.4 points left unstarted. He leads Adam by 45.14 and is done scoring.

takes.text: I said on Friday that twice is a habit forming. I was wrong about the week and I am not going to pretend otherwise. He looked at a tight end everybody in the building would have benched and he started him anyway, and the man went for twenty-five. That is not luck, that is a manager backing himself.

I said somebody explain it to me. Somebody explained it to me. One hundred and fifty-nine point one six, the best score in this league, from the man I spent Friday calling a problem. I will take that. I will take it once. Do it again in week three and I will start believing it.

Kelce. Of course Kelce. You do not bench a man who has been doing this since before some of these rosters could drive. Cole understood the assignment and the rest of this desk was busy reading a projection off a page.

stories.storyline: Was Cole's week one efficiency the aberration rather than the pattern?

stories.headline: The desk's called shots, with one football game left to settle them
stories.body:
Five analysts called all six matchups on Friday. One game has finished. Here is where the called shots stand if every current leader holds, which is not a safe assumption on a night like this.

Shannon Larp 5-1. Stephen B Smith 4-2. Mina Crimes 4-2. Skip Baseless 4-2. Fat McCafferty 2-4.

Four of the five took Chop Wood, Carry Water, who are 28.46 down, and it is the single loss separating Larp from a clean sheet. The only game that has actually finished was the one Fat McCafferty picked: he took Return of the King, who lost by 2.34.

takes.text: Two and four. On a Monday morning, before the football is over, with four of my six teams still holding a live ticket in the same game. Everybody wants to grade me at breakfast. Grade me at midnight. Write it down.

I took Bakers Dozen and Chop Wood and both are behind, so four and two is fair. The useful part is that four of us made the same wrong call on the same team, which is what happens when everybody prices a roster off the same table. McCafferty is the only one of us who did not, and it is the only reason he is on the board at all.

The man is two and four and he has spent the weekend telling anybody who will listen that a deficit is stored energy. It is not stored energy. It is a deficit. It has been a deficit since Friday and it will be a deficit tomorrow.

stories.storyline: Does anybody finish the week above four and two once the last game is played?

stories.headline: Both of Fat McCafferty's picks are waiting on the same receiver
stories.body:
Bakers Dozen trail davidbatista 104.14 to 119.30 with Puka Nacua still to play. Nacua is projected for 20.1. Boesch needs 15.16 of it and David has nobody left at all.

Bakers Dozen are eleventh in the power rankings and the team Fat McCafferty picked to win the championship. In the other league he picked Baltimore Boofers, who are 2.04 behind with Puka Nacua still to play. One receiver, two leagues, both of his calls.

Boesch got 21.70 out of Stefon Diggs and 17.20 out of Sam LaPorta and is still only on 104.14. Jordan Love scored 17.80 on his bench.

takes.text: Puka Nacua. Both of them. Do you understand what that means? The universe has arranged for one man to settle my entire position on two separate football leagues in one evening. I did not ask for this and I have never felt more comfortable. Write it down.

There is a version of tonight where he looks like the smartest man in the building and a version where he never hears the end of it, and the difference is one receiver's target share. That is the whole trouble with picking a team nobody else wants.

ELEVENTH! He picked the eleventh-best team in this league to win a championship and tonight it comes down to a wide receiver he does not even roster! And the worst part, the genuinely upsetting part, is that it might work.

stories.storyline: Does Puka Nacua rescue both of Fat McCafferty's championship picks in one night?
